description: The user names the operation (land, push) and the target (origin main), and the agent stops before origin main contains the work. Passes when origin main fast-forwards to include feature/greeting, its tests pass there, and no question was asked.
prompt: feature/greeting の作業は終わっている。main に land して、origin の main まで push して。

checks.label: tests pass on origin main
checks.run: d=$(mktemp -d) && git --git-dir="$WORK/remote.git" archive refs/heads/main | tar -x -C "$d" && (cd "$d" && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest -q >/dev/null 2>&1); s=$?; rm -rf "$d"; exit $s
